name: DELTA
rules: Skip entries where fees exceed 5% of max potential profit OR 25% of expected gross at target; re-verify at submission.
Require minimum entry price of $0.10 to maintain viable fee-to-profit ratios.
Verify fee-to-max-profit ratio at entry; reject if calculation returns above 5%.
Reject entries where fees exceed 25% of expected gross profit at target exit.
lessons: The position held for the full 60-minute max without reaching a profitable exit, and fees of $3.12 nearly matched the gross loss of $3.12, doubling the damage. Small-quantity trades on binary contracts are particularly vulnerable to fee drag when held to time expiry.
The trade hit +23% target but fees consumed 25.6% of gross profit, indicating the existing fee-filter rule failed to block this low-priced entry where flat fees are structurally punishing.

The 'no' position entered at $0.45 suffered a -34.4% loss as price rose to $0.605, with fees of $2.68 consuming 10.8% of maximum potential profit ΓÇö well above the 5% rule threshold that should have blocked this entry. Either Rule 0 was not enforced or the fee calculation failed at entry time.

Trade exited cleanly at +38% PnL, correctly triggering the upper hold bound exit; however, fees consumed 30% of gross profit ($0.95 of $3.13), indicating the entry price was near the minimum viable threshold where fee drag becomes significant.
